title: Delegation
description: projects/<slug>/delegation.json in the plant's repository: what the owner (a person) leaves to the Chief of Staff, the courier and the agents. Written only by the person through `andon delegate`. Readers read it at HEAD and trust it only when the last commit's author is the owner in andon.toml; otherwise, or when it does not pass this schema, nothing is delegated. Only these keys. That grant ids are unique, that project matches the folder and that the andon project keeps preset andon are checked by the command, not by this schema.

project.description: Project slug; must match the folder.

preset.description: Default set the grants are laid on. Absent: work.

grants.description: Additions and subtractions over the preset. For each scope, the valid grant with the latest at wins.

grant.description: One grant. value depends on scope (see allOf).

id.description: d1, d2, ...; unique in the file.

by.description: Who granted it: owner (the owner in andon.toml).

until.description: Expiry date; past it the grant is as if absent. null: no expiry.

evidence.description: Where the person said so: a path or a quote (point to it, do not copy).

revoked.description: Revocation; when present the grant is as if absent (the entry is kept for history). null: not revoked.

value.description: Highest tier the courier may merge.
Irreversible operations allowed without asking. delete-remote can never be delegated.
How far line changes may go in without the person.
